macros.name: aztext
macros.doc: The various characters used for Latin texts.

macros.name: fntcolwidth
macros.doc: \fntcolwidth is the minimum width of a column in an unnumbered table.

macros.name: fnthours
macros.doc: As a convenience, \fnthours prints the time of day when the file was processed; it uses the 24 hour clock notation.

macros.name: fontrange
macros.doc: \fontrange{⟨low⟩}{⟨high⟩} sets the character range to be output.

macros.name: fonttable
macros.doc: \fonttable{⟨font⟩} typesets a table of all the glyphs in the ⟨font⟩ (e.g., auncl10).

macros.name: fonttext
macros.doc: The command \fonttext{⟨testfont⟩} typesets an example text using the ⟨testfont⟩ (e.g. cmr10).

macros.name: ftablewidth
macros.doc: The font table’s width is the length \ftablewidth, which by default is set to the normal textwidth (or more exactly, to \hsize).

macros.name: germanparatext
macros.doc: expands to a German language paragraph, borrowed from the blindtext package [Lik05].

macros.name: glyphalternation
macros.doc: \glyphalternation{⟨T⟩}{⟨S⟩}{⟨E⟩} typesets the ⟨T⟩ glyph alternately between each glyph in the range from ⟨S⟩ to ⟨E⟩.

macros.name: glyphmixture
macros.doc: \glyphmixture{⟨T⟩}{⟨S⟩}{⟨E⟩} typesets the ⟨T⟩ (test) glyph between the glyphs in the range from ⟨S⟩ (start) to ⟨E⟩ (end).

macros.name: glyphpunct
macros.doc: \glyphpunct sets punctuation marks in combination with different sorts of letters.

macros.name: glyphseries
macros.doc: \glyphseries{⟨T⟩}{⟨S⟩}{⟨E⟩} typesets the ⟨T⟩ glyph between the glyphs in the range from ⟨S⟩ to ⟨E⟩.

macros.name: latinparatext
macros.doc: \latinparatext expands to one version of a paragraph of the traditional lorem ipsum dummy Latin text.

macros.name: pikfont
macros.doc: selects the font with encoding ⟨encoding⟩ (e.g., T1 or OMS), family ⟨family⟩ (e.g., ppl for Palatino or cmbrs for CM Bright Math (OMS)), font series ⟨series⟩ (e.g., sb for semibold of m for medium), and font shape ⟨shape⟩ (e.g., n for normal or sc for small caps).

macros.name: regulartext
macros.doc: The command \regulartext{⟨fontspec⟩} typesets the example text using ⟨fontspec⟩, for example \rmfamily\itshape or \pikfont{T1}{pnc}{m}{it}.
